purpose: 게임 의료 상처 통로 모델의 출처와 판독 한계를 기록. 수치 튜닝은 임상 예측값이 아님.

sources.title: Emergency War Surgery, Third United States Revision (2004)
sources.edition: Third United States Revision, 2004, Borden Institute; inspected PDF copyright/printing page vi
sources.hosting: Internet Archive mirror; current official 2018 PDF is a different edition

locations.claim: Skeletal muscle, blood vessels and skin may rebound after temporary displacement; inelastic liver may fracture. This does not validate numerical tissue multipliers.
M193 fragments at cannelure after about 12 cm tissue, but no numerical striking-velocity threshold is given.
AK-47 FMJ 713 m/s, 7.89 g; 10% gelatin; text says yaw starts after 25 cm. Profile ends at 74 cm.
M193 55 gr/3.6 g, 943 m/s, final 35 gr/2.3 g, 36% fragmentation. Text: forward travel about 12 cm; M855 shows a similar pattern. AK-74 yaw about 7 cm, no AK-74 illustration on this page.
7.62 mm NATO 150 gr/9.7 g, 862 m/s. Text on prior page: yaw after about 16 cm. Complete profile, nonfragmenting.

limits: No separate M855 profile is printed: using M193 is the explicitly declared proxy allowed by S1.
No pistol profile appears in this chapter.
The figures are idealized whole gelatin paths from 5–10 m firing; they do not define an invariant wound in heterogeneous human anatomy.
Charts have an axial cm scale but no independent vertical scale; diameter readings assume the diagram is drawn to equal physical x/y scale. Diameter uncertainty includes that assumption.

sources.title: Emergency War Surgery, Fifth Edition (2018), Chapter 1 — Weapons Effects and War Wounds

locations.claim: Elastic skeletal muscle/vessels/skin can stretch and rebound; inelastic liver/bone may fracture.
5.56 rounds may fragment at the cannelure after about 12 cm in soft tissue.

limits: The current official chapter has a generic tissue-interaction diagram only; it omits individual AK-47, AK-74, M193, M855 and pistol wound-profile plots. It cannot be cited as the source for individual plot dimensions.

sources.author: M. L. Fackler
sources.title: What's Wrong with the Wound Ballistics Literature, and Why
sources.edition: Letterman Army Institute of Research, Institute Report No. 239, July 1987, AD-A183285

locations.claim: Elastic bowel wall, lung and muscle relatively resist temporary stretching; liver does not. Quantitative tissue coefficients are not supplied.
Cautions that deposited kinetic energy alone is not a tissue-damage measure; fragmentation and tissue material properties materially change the outcome.
M16/M193 943 m/s, 55 gr/3.6 g; 36% fragmentation; 36 cm final depth.
7.62 NATO 862 m/s, 150 gr/9.7 g, 64 cm depth; caption states yaw starts 15 cm and maximal yaw near 28 cm.
AK-74 935 m/s, 53 gr/3.4 g, 52 cm final depth; two temporary-cavity lobes.

limits: Report PDF and GIFs were both visually inspected. The report is a military research primary source preserved by a third-party mirror.
The report cites Fackler et al., J Trauma 1984;24:263–266 for AK-74; that original 1984 full text was not independently retrieved.
Equal-axis assumption and chart blur limit measured cavity diameters.
Does not verify a universal 823 m/s M193/M855 fragmentation threshold.

sources.title: Gunshot wounds in parenchymatous organs: the morphology mainly depends on the physical properties of the affected tissues
sources.journal: International Journal of Legal Medicine 137 (2023), starts p.1463

locations.claim: 10% gelatin, 20×20×30 cm composite block, porcine organs; 9 mm Luger round-nose FMJ 7.5 g, stated manufacturer muzzle velocity342 m/s; firing distance1.6 m.
All shots perforated 30 cm blocks. Temporary cavities approximately cylindrical; no calibrated maximum diameter or final stopping depth is reported.

Temporary-cavity volume correlates with transferred energy; dense liver/spleen/kidney develop radiating tears, while highly elastic lung tolerates distortion much better. Vessels stretch more than adjacent parenchyma.

limits: Authors explicitly say the study is qualitative, without a claim to quantification.
Excised anaemic porcine organs and uninflated lungs; findings valid for the tested 9 mm FMJ and cannot validate exact high-velocity-rifle numerical coefficients.
342 m/s is a manufacturer muzzle-velocity statement, not measured impact velocity at the block.
No 9 mm Fackler whole gelatin profile or stop depth is supplied by this paper.

sources.title: Quantitative wound ballistic analysis of gelatin head phantoms by computed tomography using the total crack length method

locations.claim: Cavity volume/energy relation in ballistic soap uses a proportionality constant; gelatin crack profiles correlate with energy transfer per specific depth.
Gelatin total crack length is described as proportional to cavity volume and energy transferred per unit length; reference1 is Kneubuehl, General wound ballistics,2022,p87–162.

limits: Supports a calibrated simulant approximation, not a universal r=k√(dE/dx) law for human organs.
The game square-root radius relation, k, thresholds, and translation into irreversible organ severity remain tuning.

sources.title: Emergency War Surgery Fifth Edition, Chapter15 Head Injuries

locations.claim: Head-injury mechanisms and ICP/CPP context; cortex injury outcomes vary, hypotension/hypoxia worsen function.

limits: Does not validate a numeric brain temporary-cavity coefficient1.0 or any universal immediate collapse for all nearby temporary cavities. Those are game tuning/clinical policy.

locations.claim: Mean CO5.25L/min,range4.0–8.0L/min for each ventricle separately, based on mean70mL SV and75bpm.

limits: Supports a resting flow reference, not gunshot aortic orifice flow, a1.7reserve factor, collider lumen size, or a30s consciousness threshold. All such choices are game tuning.

verified: EWS2004 p1.8 describes yaw/deformation/cannelure breakup at 943m/s and says M855 pattern is similar.
Fackler1987 Figure2 proves substantial fragmentation for M193 at943m/s.
notVerified: A primary literature boundary separating fragment/no-fragment at823m/s or762m/s.
A lot-invariant or entry-yaw-invariant universal threshold.
fragmentationThresholdReview.implementationPolicy: Use original registry terminalEffect.thresholdVelocity values (M193780m/s,M855760m/s) as S1 fragmentation-threshold tuning borrowed from a differently purposed original value. No primary-paper fragmentation threshold was verified. Preserve the original registry and flight behavior; record this semantic change in the3D ledger.

sourceVsTuningRules: 도판의 선에서 읽은 치수만 출처(도판 판독)이며, 판독 오차와 축척 가정 포함.
직접 도판이 없는 탄에 차용한 값은 추정; 같은 탄이라는 뜻이 아님.
Cd, k, 조직수치계수, 피해배율정규화, 파편구름의 균질방사모형, 회전곡선 형태는 튜닝.
공동 부피와 에너지 연관은 균질 simulant의 보정 관계로 제한한다. 에너지전달=사람조직손상이라는 등식은 쓰지 않는다.
원문논문/PDF는 artifacts/s1-sources에만 보관하고 다운로드 게임 ZIP에 넣지 않는다.
